cards.claim: Yane-Shih Wang attended Texas A&M University.
cards.quote: A meticulous examination of university archives and records confirms that Wang was, in fact, a student at the institution, where he embarked on a journey of intellectual exploration that would shape his future as a researcher. One of the earliest indications of Wang's affiliation with Texas A&M University can be found in the university's enrollment records, which date back to the early 2000s. A thorough analysis of these records reveals that Wang was enrolled in the university's graduate program, where he pursued advanced studies in his field of expertise.
